blocks.text: Zero Trust Browser allows for clipboard use during an isolation session. Depending on your isolation profile settings set by your administrator, you can do one of the following:

blocks.item: Copy content from your local computer and paste to isolation.
Copy content from isolation and paste to your local computer.
Copy and paste content to and from your local computer and isolation.
Neither copy nor paste content to or from your local computer and isolation.

blocks.text: To learn more about isolation profile settings, see Creating Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS and Creating Isolation Profiles for Private Access.

During an isolation session, you can access the clipboard from the Zero Trust Mode menu. Click the Clipboard icon to use clipboard functions (e.g., copy and paste) and view notifications about restrictions configured for your isolation profile. You can also view, search, and delete content stored in the clipboard. Content stored in the clipboard is limited to the last 25 items copied.
To learn more about the Zero Trust Mode menu and its options, see Using the Zero Trust Mode Menu in Native Browser Experience.
To learn more about limitations related to clipboard data, see Ranges & Limitations.
